detail.zh-CN: 详情分为预览、概览、过程、参数；成片可以逐帧看，画面可以放大比对。
detail.en: Details split into Preview, Summary, Timeline and Options; step through videos frame by frame and zoom into any frame.

detail.zh-CN: 渲染中途停下后，在软件里点“继续渲染”，或用 multiplane resume，从停下的地方接着渲。
detail.en: After a render stops part way, choose Resume in the app or run multiplane resume to continue from where it stopped.

detail.zh-CN: 点托盘图标就能看到进行中、排队和最近完成的作业。
detail.en: Click the tray icon to see running, queued and recently finished jobs.

detail.zh-CN: 窗口先出来，作业读完就显示；深色主题不再闪一下浅色。
detail.en: The window shows at once and jobs appear as soon as they are read; no light flash in the dark theme.

detail.zh-CN: 关于页按界面语言列出每个版本的变化，跳过的版本也能看到。
detail.en: The About page lists what changed in your language, including versions you skipped.

detail.zh-CN: 运动帧不再重复做静止检查，快 2～9%，画面不变。
detail.en: Motion frames skip a redundant still check: 2–9% faster with identical output.

detail.zh-CN: 浏览器卡住时自动重启并重做这一帧，画面不变，并给出提示。
detail.en: A stuck browser is restarted and the frame rendered again, with the same pixels and a warning.

detail.zh-CN: 停止时有浏览器卡住，5 秒后直接关掉它；已编好的段保留，可以续传。
detail.en: A browser stuck while stopping is closed after 5 seconds; finished segments are kept for resuming.

detail.zh-CN: 项目根目录是相对路径时，显示实际的文件夹名。
detail.en: Relative project roots now show the actual folder name.
